svg.title: Workspace inbound Private Link and Spark outbound managed private endpoint to Azure SQL

desc.style: fill: rgb(0, 0, 0); stroke: none; stroke-width: 1px; stroke-dasharray: none; font-family: "Segoe UI", Aptos, Calibri, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, sans-serif; font-size: 17px; font-weight: 400;

svg.desc: Official Azure and Fabric icons show two independently controlled paths. A VM in the customer VNet reaches OneLake through a workspace-bound customer private endpoint. Fabric Spark in a separate managed VNet reaches external Azure SQL through a Fabric-managed private endpoint. A second customer SQL endpoint is used only for VM administration. The connection arrows and data-return arrows are labeled separately.
